constraints.definition: CHECK (event = 'policy_allowed'::text AND outcome = 'allowed'::text AND status = 200 OR event = 'policy_candidate'::text AND outcome = 'candidate'::text AND status = 200 OR event = 'rate_denied'::text AND outcome = 'rate_limited'::text AND status = 429 OR event = 'control_denied'::text AND (outcome = ANY (ARRAY['disabled'::text, 'failed_closed'::text])) AND status = 503 OR event = 'policy_error'::text AND (outcome = ANY (ARRAY['failed_closed'::text, 'timeout'::text])) AND status = 503)

CHECK (state = 'pending'::text AND claim_hash IS NULL AND lease_expires_ms IS NULL OR (state = ANY (ARRAY['claimed'::text, 'acked'::text])) AND claim_hash IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_ms IS NOT NULL AND generation > 0 AND attempts > 0)
CHECK (state = 'acked'::text AND acknowledged_ms IS NOT NULL AND acknowledgement_hash IS NOT NULL OR state <> 'acked'::text AND acknowledged_ms IS NULL AND acknowledgement_hash IS NULL)

CHECK (state = 'acked'::text AND acknowledged_ms IS NOT NULL AND acknowledgement_hash IS NOT NULL OR state <> 'acked'::text AND acknowledged_ms IS NULL AND acknowledgement_hash IS NULL)

CHECK (state = 'acked'::text AND acknowledged_ms IS NOT NULL AND acknowledgement_hash IS NOT NULL OR state <> 'acked'::text AND acknowledged_ms IS NULL AND acknowledgement_hash IS NULL)
